note: A SegmentedVolumeData: all voxels are 255 and a second volume of identifiers gives the segment of each column (0, 0, 1, 2). Two styles colour segment 0 red and segment 1 green; segment 2 has no style, so it keeps the plain voxel colour (white). Disabling segment 1 makes it transparent.
gaps: X_ITE reads the segment as int(r * 255), which truncates; the bridge rounds (no difference for exact ids, and none for a 1 voxel texture of ids with nearest filtering)
the segment ids are read through the texture's own filtering, so a segmentIdentifiers volume of 16 or more voxels across is blended at the segment borders in both engines
